help.cre:simulate:
Usage: npm run --silent cre:simulate -- [--deny-budget] [--capture] [--json]
Run the live Sepolia USDC preview (6 decimals); no broadcast or payment.
Default: request 10000 (0.01 USDC), cap 100000 (0.1 USDC).
--deny-budget  Request twice the cap; expected DENY is success (exit 0).
--capture      Back up and replace repository/frontend evidence after verification.
--json         One schemaVersion=1 envelope on stdout; progress on stderr.
--help         Show help without loading config, credentials or networking.
Requires Bun, CRE login/account access, Coinbase and Sepolia RPC connectivity.
Exit: 0 expected decision; 1 execution/validation failure; 2 usage/config error; 130/143 interrupted.
help.cre:dry-run:
Usage: npm run --silent cre:dry-run -- [--recording-window SECONDS] [--save-evidence] [--json]
Run ALLOW and budget DENY previews sequentially; no broadcast or replacement of captures.
--recording-window SECONDS  Required freshness headroom, integer 1..3600 (default 600).
                           --recording-window=SECONDS is also accepted.
--save-evidence             Save a new directory under docs/evidence/preflight (default .local/cre/preflight).
--json                      One readiness envelope on stdout; progress on stderr.
--help                      Show help without running CRE.
Exit: 0 both expected outcomes with headroom; 1 not ready/execution failure; 2 usage error; 130/143 interrupted.
help.cre:simulate:write:
Usage: npm run --silent cre:simulate:write -- [--broadcast] [--capture] [--json]
Isolated Sepolia mock-forwarder demo; workflow identity is NOT authenticated.
This receiver records reports and cannot authorize or settle payments.
Default: simulate report delivery without broadcasting.
--broadcast  Send a testnet report; requires ALLOW_SIMULATION_DEMO=true and dedicated DEMO_PRIVATE_KEY.
--capture    With --broadcast, save verified receipt evidence under docs/evidence/onchain-demo.
             Without --broadcast, retain local evidence only.
--json       One result envelope on stdout; progress on stderr.
--help       Show help without reading secrets, contacting RPC or sending a transaction.
Requires Bun, CRE, Sepolia RPC and .local/cre/demo-deployment.json from deploy:cre-demo.
Exit: 0 verified simulation/receipt; 1 execution/receipt failure; 2 usage/config error; 130/143 interrupted.
help.demo:check:
Usage: npm run --silent demo:check -- [--json] [--help]
Read-only check of a legacy Sepolia tUSD deployment and wallet; never mints or approves.
Requires PRIVATE_KEY_1, AGENTPAY_STREAM_ADDRESS, PAYMENT_TOKEN_ADDRESS,
PAYMENT_RECIPIENT_ADDRESS; SEPOLIA_RPC_URL defaults to publicnode.
Verifies chain 11155111, deployed bytecode, 18 decimals and stream/token binding.
Zero gas balance fails; low tUSD is reported because demo:consumer may mint test tokens.
--json  One result envelope on stdout; diagnostics on stderr. Raw token units are decimal strings.
--help  No environment, network or wallet use.
Exit: 0 configured with gas; 1 RPC/deployment/balance failure; 2 usage/config error.
help.demo:consumer:
Usage: npm run --silent demo:consumer -- [--json] [--help]
Run the existing legacy tUSD demo against http://localhost:3005/api/premium.
This command CAN mint, approve and escrow test tokens and spend Sepolia test ETH.
Requires PRIVATE_KEY_1, AGENTPAY_STREAM_ADDRESS, PAYMENT_TOKEN_ADDRESS,
PAYMENT_RECIPIENT_ADDRESS; optional SEPOLIA_RPC_URL and GEMINI_API_KEY.
Preflight requires Sepolia 11155111, 18-decimal tUSD and matching stream/token.
The SDK negotiates a 3600-second stream; rates are 18-decimal units per second.
This is AgentPay-specific HTTP 402, not full current x402 transport.
--json  One final result envelope; progress on stderr; raw units as strings.
--help  Show help without reading keys, minting, approving or making requests.
Exit: 0 all four provider requests succeeded; 1 operation failure; 2 usage/config error.
help.demo:provider:
Usage: npm run --silent demo:provider -- [--json] [--help]
Start the legacy tUSD HTTP provider on port 3005 (no wallet needed).
Requires AGENTPAY_STREAM_ADDRESS, PAYMENT_TOKEN_ADDRESS, PAYMENT_RECIPIENT_ADDRESS;
SEPOLIA_RPC_URL defaults to publicnode. Verifies Sepolia, code, 18 decimals and token binding.
Rates: /api/premium = 0.0001 tUSD/s; /api/ai-insight = 0.001 tUSD/s.
Stream IDs alone are not authenticated payer identities. No guarded receipt integration.
--json  Emit one readiness envelope after binding; subsequent logs on stderr.
--help  Show help without RPC or starting a listener.
Exit: 1 startup/RPC/deployment failure; 2 usage/config error; otherwise runs until stopped.
